headline: Spectrum News NECN launches regional network across New England
dek: The rebranded 24/7 service is available to existing NECN viewers, with reporting planned across all six New England states and a new morning show coming later this year.
body: Spectrum News NECN launched Sept. 23 as a rebranded regional news network serving viewers across Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and Vermont.

Charter Communications, Spectrum's parent company, said the network is initially available to existing NECN distributors and will expand to additional viewers in the coming months. The service is led by Senior News Director Teisha Parker and is hiring staff throughout New England.

Veteran New England journalist Matt Reed is the network's primary anchor at launch and is slated to anchor a new morning show later this year. The company said the 24/7 service will carry local headlines every 15 minutes and weather updates every 10 minutes.

The relaunch revives the NECN name, which dates to the network's original 1992 launch. Spectrum News said customers can also find the service through its mobile app, Xumo Stream Box, Roku and Apple TV.

The launch adds another regionwide news outlet at a time when local television and digital organizations are competing for audiences across six states. Charter said it plans to continue building the network's New England staff in the months ahead.
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: Spectrum News NECN Launches Across New England
seoDescription: Spectrum News NECN launched as a 24/7 regional network covering all six New England states, with a new morning show planned for later this year.
